description: Source code implementing the Label Propagation algorithm for community detection in graphs within Apache Spark's GraphX library.

classes.name: LabelPropagation

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the static Label Propagation algorithm on a given graph for a specified number of supersteps, returning a graph with vertex labels indicating community affiliation.
